secrets.name: VITE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Manus OAuth app ID — needed for sign-in. Obtain from Manus dashboard.

secrets.name: VITE_OAUTH_PORTAL_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth portal base URL (e.g. https://oauth.manus.space). Needed for sign-in.

secrets.name: OAUTH_SERVER_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth server URL for backend token exchange. Only needed if running the Express backend.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus Forge API base URL — for storage, LLM, heartbeat. Only needed if running the Express backend.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge API key — for storage, LLM, heartbeat. Only needed if running the Express backend.

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret for signing session JWTs. Only needed if running the Express backend.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: MySQL connection string for the Drizzle ORM. Only needed if running the Express backend.
